author: robertjJ513DS

title: Valentina is an excellent guide!!
text: Valentina is an excellent tour guide.  Super knowledgeable and very friendly.  We did the private walking tour of the Gothic Quarter followed by a private tour of the Picasso Museum.  Both were excellent but the Picasso tour was outstanding!!  Valentina was so great with the order in which we toured, the explanations and interpretations of techniques and periods during Picasso’s life.  I can’t imagine we would have gotten the same experience if we’d visited without Valentina!!

title: Fantastic Tour of the Gothic Quarter
text:
We had a fantastic time on our tour of the Gothic Quarter.  Jordi was a great tour guide.  We learned so much about the rich history of Barcelona, architecture, and the importance of the patron Saint Eulalia to the people of Barcelona.  Jordi made the history of Barcelona come alive and it was a time we will never forget.  Thank you, Jordi!  
Robin & Jose
